feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. The evidence is iterations 0 to 8. Iteration 8 (y = 0.06 m, score 403.72) is the best raced design: the oval finish rate rose to 0.95 and s-bend and slalom progress rose to 0.58 and 0.16. Hold y = 0.06 m as the base. The s-bend max_error (0.066 m) and slalom max_error (0.065 m) are still above the 0.06 m off-track limit, and the forward row raised s-bend steering_oscillation from 0.27 to 0.36 (iteration 1 to iteration 8). So the forward offset increases response on bends and the controller is now the limit, which is why this candidate adds kd 0.8. Iterations 2 to 5 show that sensor_size 0.016, wheel_track 0.10, and mass 0.6 or 0.7 each cut the oval finish rate, so those stay fixed. Depending on the next race: if s-bend max_error stays above 0.06 m with oscillation still around 0.36, the next geometry test is y = 0.07 m with the same 12 mm row and the same controller. Do not move y before the controller result is known.
